name: dstack (Dstack-TEE)
summary: Open framework for confidential AI: runs model-serving containers inside Intel TDX / AMD SEV-SNP confidential VMs with NVIDIA H100 confidential computing, so weights stay encrypted in memory and unreadable even to a compromised host, with remote attestation for verifiable deployment.

name: Confidential Computing Zoo (CCZoo)
summary: Intel's collection of code-ready reference solutions applying TEE (SGX/TDX), homomorphic encryption, and remote attestation to real cloud business scenarios, including cloud-native AI inference on AWS/Azure/Alibaba/Tencent.

name: TamperBench
summary: Benchmark for the tamper-resistance of open-weight LLMs: red-teams models with fine-tuning, jailbreak-tuning, and embedding attacks under worst-case hyperparameter sweeps while tracking StrongREJECT safety and MMLU-Pro utility.
